research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Values
bullets: Prepared tabular classification data by checking label consistency, documenting missingness patterns, and fitting preprocessing transformations on training partitions only.
Implemented prescribed logistic regression and random forest baselines, comparing imputation strategies through stratified cross validation and summarizing classification errors.

research.title: Regression Baselines for Seasonal Demand Prediction
bullets: Cleaned timestamped demand records, aligned calendar covariates, and constructed lagged predictors using past observations within the specified forecasting setup.
Implemented ridge regression and historical average baselines under a supplied evaluation protocol, inspecting residual patterns across chronological validation partitions.

work.title: Backend Record Validation and Processing
bullets: Maintained Python backend routines for validating incoming records, normalizing field formats, and returning structured errors for malformed requests.
Added regression tests for record processing edge cases and investigated failed jobs using application logs and reproducible input examples.

projects.title: Gaussian Naive Bayes Classification Baseline
bullets: Implemented Gaussian naive Bayes in NumPy using class conditional means, variances, and log probabilities for a tabular classification assignment.
Checked predictions against scikit-learn on identical data splits and examined confusion matrices to describe common classification errors.
